rationale: Base flow on l12 (118 MW) exceeds its 100 MW limit. No single action removes the overload: open_tie_13 gives 110 MW, shed_bus3_15 gives 104 MW, shed_bus2_10 gives 109 MW. Combining open_tie_13 (l12 -8) with shed_bus3_15 (l12 -14) yields l12 = 118-8-14 = 96 MW, within limit. l23 = 72+12-6 = 78 MW (limit 90), and opened l13 = 0 MW. Total shedding 15 MW is less than the alternative open_tie_13 + shed_bus2_10 which leaves l12 at 101 MW (infeasible), and shed_bus3_15 + shed_bus2_10 which sheds 25 MW. Uses 2 of max 2 actions and 15 of max 25 MW, minimizing shedding.
